description.value:
You single out a target within range, who must succeed on a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the next time the target makes an attack roll or saving throw, it must roll a d4 and subtract the result; the power then ends.

The die used increases to a d6 at 5th level, a d8 at 11th level, and a d10 at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, At-Will
